developmentBacklogAdded.name: Direct-company escalation cache
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: A job-board hit can be stronger and fresher on the employer career page, but repeatedly rediscovering the primary source wastes time and risks duplicate lineage.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Persist a title+company to canonical-career URL cache with last verified timestamp so every matching board hit automatically escalates to the direct source before scoring/dedupe.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Growth-path fit extractor
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Entry support roles may be strategically valuable when the employer explicitly offers progression into WordPress, web operations or technical ownership, but current ranking mainly scores immediate duties.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Extract explicit training/progression paths and add a bounded strategic-fit bonus only when the next-step skill matches target tracks such as WordPress/WooCommerce, IT support or e-commerce operations.
